messages.content: Write a polished short scene in modern American English that opens with two adult friends already in the middle of an ordinary activity. Avoid an exposition-heavy introduction. Establish the situation naturally through dialogue, action, and a few concrete details. Keep the writing contemporary and grounded.

“Hold this.”

Jordan handed Alex the screwdriver before Alex could ask why.

“What am I holding?”

“The screwdriver.”

“I figured that out.”

“Good. We're making progress.”

Alex looked down at the half-assembled shelf between them. “You know, most people read the instructions first.”

Jordan glanced at the booklet lying upside down on the floor.

“I was going to.”

“When?”

“Eventually.”

Alex smiled and turned the booklet right-side up. “Start with step one.”

“I don't like step one.”

“You haven't even read it.”

“I can tell.”

Alex shook her head and handed the booklet over.

Jordan studied the picture for a moment. “Oh.”

“What?”

“We put that piece on backward.”

Alex stared at the shelf.

“How long have we been doing this?”

“Twenty minutes.”

“And we just figured that out?”

“Correct.”

Alex laughed. “Okay. Turn it around.”

Jordan picked up the shelf.

“Carefully.”

“I know.”

“You say that right before you do something careless.”

Jordan paused. “That's hurtful.”

“Turn it around.”

They both started laughing before the shelf had even moved.
